name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Exactly two of the angler who landed the Crappie, the angler who landed the Perch, the angler who landed the Pike, and the angler fishing with Corn belong to the South Watershed.
Either Mabel belongs to the Sunfish Family or both members of the North Watershed belong to the Sunfish Family.
Between Gus and Willowmere, one goes with Perch and the other with Dough.
Either Royce belongs to the North Watershed or both members of the Sunfish Family belong to the North Watershed.
Pike, Grayreach, and Dough go with Gus, Mabel, and Royce, in some order.
Willowmere goes with exactly two of Royce, Perch, and Maggot.
